systemMessage: Combat Writing: Node is not on the PATH, or the node found there does not run, so the plugin cannot run: its commands and its hooks are Node scripts. Your own work is not stopped. The plugin stops only its own reader; an agent of your own named exactly seat is taken for it, and on a machine with no grep a Read, a Write and a start of an agent are refused too. Install Node and start a new session, or turn the plugin off with /plugin.

hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: Combat Writing is installed, but Node is not on the PATH or does not run, so none of its scripts or hooks can run in this session. When the person asks for a /cw: command, say that Node must be installed first and a new session started; run no script of the plugin and start no cw:seat agent.
